tickets.title: Year-End Deadline Sweep
tickets.text: Confirm active status of the Thimblefern household's homeowner and umbrella policies with Amber Teapot Insurance and verify mortgagee evidence requirements, since the renewal packet showed the policies could lapse because a premium draft used a closed card and the grace-period notice reached the prior address.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to confirm those items by June 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Change recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Confirm the requested recurring payment change, verify the effective timing with the provider or custodian, and document the old and new payment method or amount without storing unnecessary sensitive details. Update the Thimblefern household's Amber Teapot Insurance premium drafts from the canceled Teacup Comet Bank debit card to the joint checking account at Teacup Comet Bank for the homeowner and umbrella policies.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to address that payment-route change by July 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client reports a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. The Thimblefern household moved to Durham, North Carolina on May 18, 2024; align Amber Teapot Insurance records (currently showing the former townhouse address) with the mortgage records, advisory household profile, and deed information to ensure correct notices and proof-of-coverage routing.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing. The Thimblefern household moved to Durham, North Carolina on May 18, 2024.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields. Ensure Amber Teapot Insurance records are aligned with the new Durham address.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements. The Durham move may affect North Carolina state tax assumptions and insurance coverage routing.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to align the records by July 3, 2024.
